caption: A cat walks up to a floor-length mirror and sees another cat approaching it in the glass.

sa.check: A cat walks up to a floor-length mirror.
Another cat approaches it in the glass.
The reflected cat is a mirror image of the real one.
Their noses meet at the glass.

pc.expect: The reflected cat approaches as the real cat does, at the same time and pace, and their noses meet at the glass.
pc.fail: The reflection stays still while the cat walks; or moves first or later; or the noses meet away from the glass.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image: the same cat, same markings, facing the real one across the surface.
pc.fail: It is a different cat; or shows the cat's back; or it is a rotated copy with the markings on the wrong side.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves while the cat sits still; or it turns away by itself.

pc.expect: The mirror is flat and rigid: the reflection is undistorted.
pc.fail: The surface ripples; or the reflection warps while the cat is unchanged; or the mirror bends.

pc.expect: One cat and one reflection; the reflection stays inside the mirror.
pc.fail: The reflection steps out of the mirror; or a second cat appears in the room; or the cat passes into the glass; or the cat vanishes.

pc.expect: The cat's markings and the mirror frame stay the same, and the reflection's colours match the cat's.
pc.fail: The cat changes colour; or the frame changes; or the reflection's colours drift from the cat's.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the reflection's relation to it is. Mirror geometry: each point of the image lies directly across the mirror surface from the real point, so the image is a mirror copy, not a rotated one.
